natural_exact_probe_failure.clock: Native host tracefs monotonic seconds, not guest uptime or wall time.
natural_exact_probe_failure.analysis_method: Join by owned TID (including <...>), vCPU index and APIC identity. Pair each retained accepted/get_interrupt/guest_before/guest_after; pair each EOI before/after and check highest ISR bit is removed with no bits added.

coverage.limitation: Old collector assigned anonymous comm records to other reserve. No anonymous failed CPU0 record survives; overwritten other records prevent proof that none were lost. Counts and pairs describe retained events, not a certified uninterrupted CPU0 history.

natural_exact_probe_failure.conclusion: Last retained timer acceptance completes QEMU dispatch to the expected entry PC. Subsequent retained IPIs are acknowledged while timer236 remains in ISR. Host helper return does not prove execution of Linux handler instructions.
natural_exact_probe_failure.remaining_discriminator: Guest instruction execution at IDT entry and timer acknowledgement in the exact Debian kernel, with verified owned-TID retention. Existing APIC/IOTLB/serial/QMP outputs do not contain this instruction flow.
